description: Safety rules applied to every instruction before it reaches a protocol. An instruction matching `forbiddenInstructions` is removed (and the removal recorded). A parameter matching `qualifiedTriggers` in its title/description is marked requiresQualifiedInspector. If removing unsafe instructions leaves a parameter with none, it is dropped. Baseline instructions are written to pass these rules; the verify suite checks that they do.

forbiddenInstructions.reason: Requires disassembly; risk of damage or injury (lithium cells, mains voltage).

forbiddenInstructions.pattern: \b(drive|driving|road test|test drive)\b[^.]{0,40}\b(high speed|top speed|highway|expressway|public road|full throttle)\b

forbiddenInstructions.reason: Can damage the image sensor; specialist task.

qualifiedTriggers.pattern: \b(gas leak|gas pressure|pressure test|insulation resistance|pat test|earth(ing)? test|output voltage|load test|rigging|structural load|brake test|road test)\b
qualifiedTriggers.reason: Needs a qualified technician and suitable equipment.
